children: Titan International entered into a Sale and Purchase Agreement to sell all equity interests of Italtractor ITM to USCO for approximately $207 million in cash, plus up to about $6 million in an earnout tied to 2026 performance, subject to customary adjustments. Closing is expected in January 2027, pending regulatory approvals and other conditions. Titan plans to use proceeds to reduce debt and fund strategic growth, and the deal includes transition services and a five-year non-compete in specified jurisdictions.
